activities\"},\"form-type\":\"competition\",\"description-proc\":{\"eng\":\"As part of its ongoing efforts to pursue its sustainable development goals and achieve the ambitions set out by the normalized.title: Horizon scanning for radical innovation breakthroughs.
normalized.description:
The overall objective of this study is to build forward-looking strategic intelligence in science, technology and innovation with a view to identifying potentially important cross-cutting, disruptive innovations.
In particular, the work of the contractor will involve the systematic collection of information on key future radical (technological and societal) innovation breakthroughs which are currently at the stage of aspirations and the evaluation of their potential importance for Europe.
